title: Central lists this record, but no retained version is available
what_happened: ODK Central lists this logical submission as present, but when MethodMesh asked Central for its retained version history, Central returned zero versions.
what_to_do: Investigate why Central exposes the logical submission without a retained version. Until that is explained or resolved, do not describe this record as independently verified by MethodMesh.
why_it_matters: MethodMesh has no retained record version from which to reconstruct and independently verify the record's provenance. This does not show that the research data are wrong; it means the provenance chain is incomplete for this record.
